The saturate-specific RS482 oracle is now retained in evidence PR #386: https://github.com/Oichkatzelesfrettschen/steinmarder-r300/pull/386

The safe EGL surfaceless GL test uses `GL_INTENSITY8`, `C_d=0.50`, and cases `(C_s,A_s)=(0.25,0.75)` and `(0.75,0.25)`. The OpenGL oracle expects `0.625` and `0.6875`.

Four complete profiles with the merged carrier-safe ZERO mapping return `0.4980354` for both cases. Profiles exposing native `SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE` return `0.5607834` and `0.8745041`, matching a source-color alias rather than the spec factor. The calibrated selftest passes known-good and known-bad classifications, and the retained log binds the oracle source, binary, runner, host, format, state, and loader hashes.

This evidence rejects both preserving native SAT and retaining ZERO as a conformant completion. The row stays unresolved: a future fix must supply fragment alpha independently of the one-component carrier and reproduce `0.625` and `0.6875`; that is the explicit falsifier. No Mesa behavior change is proposed by this evidence PR.

Evidence-bound status on merged main: origin/main still maps RGB SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE to ZERO for R300_BLEND_TARGET_INTENSITY in r300_state_inlines.h:37-43, and the direct blend-factor test asserts that mapping. The safe GL-only RS482 run (PCI 1002:5974, GL_RENDERER ATI RS480; dmesg access denied) is retained at /var/tmp/r300-intensity-saturate-vostro1000-20260812.log, SHA256 346297801d57cb81102952f0f8cbd96e7a6d2256f15e5f01205e45b7bd452525. Its calibrated intensity cases expect 0.625 and 0.6875; retained profiles classify the observed mapping as ZERO, source_color_alias, or other, and the carrier-safe ZERO profiles return 0.4980354 for both cases. A native SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE profile returns source-color-alias values rather than the spec factor. This evidence falsifies both retaining native SAT and treating ZERO as a conformant completion. The row remains unresolved. Explicit falsifier: a reviewed mechanism that supplies fragment alpha independently of the one-component carrier, followed by a safe GL-only exact-RS482 run reproducing both expected values. No Mesa behavior change or hardware claim is made here.

The current r300 state mapping still lacks a saturate-specific intensity-target oracle. The existing RS480 evidence covers unit-alpha ONE and SRC_ALPHA cases only; it does not establish SRC_ALPHA_SATURATE for I8 or I32 destinations. I leave this hardware/conformance row unresolved until a spec-grounded test and exact silicon result or a conformant fallback are retained.
